_comment: ART-003 Retail lookdev, first pass. Plan feet (+x east, +y south) as graybox_layout.json. Heights/materials/fixture types from the TI set (REFERENCES_INDEX §6, DEC-037); every position or extent below is a layout choice unless it names a graybox fixture. Built by Dispo.Editor.Lookdev.LookdevBuilder into Scenes/Retail_Lookdev.unity (additive, never hand-edited, DEC-029).

ceiling.note: PT-1 painted gypsum 9'-0" (TI A101, §6.1); covers the graybox Retail room rect

soffit.note: 7'-6" gypsum soffit (TI §6.1, High); extent not in the plan: a 2'-0" perimeter band on N/E/W walls; none on the S wall so the arches stay clear

panels.note: CLG-1 dark-walnut suspended acoustic panels 4'x8' on stainless cable (TI §6.1/§6.5, High type); drop height and the 4x2 grid over the sales floor are layout choices (photos 01/05/10 show dark baffles, no count); the builder drops any panel within cameraClear of a Retail CCTV camera (REVIEW-W4F m2)

floors.note: TL-1 Statuario-look porcelain 12x24 x 3/8", retail field (TI §6.5)
TL-2 8x8 patterned tile in the counter zones (TI §6.5); zone extent = staff aisle of the north run up to its deli back counter (ROOM_FIXTURES rev7), layout choice
staff aisle of the east return (rev7, GAP-130), layout choice
staff aisle of the south register run (rev7, GAP-129; BAND 10 shows TL-2 there), layout choice

millwork.note: A940 base cabinets: top 2'-10" (34") max AFF, 4" toe, 2" QZ-2 white quartz top (A940 detail 11, the POS cabinet, REFERENCES_INDEX §6.4; the 1-1/2" edge is detail 12 / 4D, REVIEW-W4F m1), WD-1/PL-1 walnut fronts, black toe (TI §6.4). Footprints are the graybox fixtures (current plan). The south run (the plan's DELI COUNTER, REF-011) gets the same build as the north run.

jarWalls.note: DEC-043 photo: teal curved-leaf wall behind dark-gray metal shelves; the lowest jar row is a black counter top over walnut drawer fronts. Shelf rows/rects come from graybox jarSlots: per deli wall (N/E/S, REF-011) a back-counter run (black top over walnut) and two metal tiers; every jar stays on a shelf anchor. Stainless tong cups are not modelled (Nolan)

wallWash.note: REVIEW-W3D: the jar walls read too dark. Adjustable LED accents aimed at the jar walls (TI L4 type family, 3500 K); positions and aim are layout choices

neon.note: white neon 'Fine Cannabis' (photo 05, register side); bottom at 72" AFF (TI A901, High). Wall and size are layout choices; lettering is a Barlow Light stand-in

downlights.note: L4A/L4B 4-1/2" LED downlights in the gypsum ceiling, 3500 K (TI E-sheet §6.7, High type); grid pitch is a layout choice; positions under a CLG-1 panel are skipped, positions in the soffit band drop to the soffit

pendants.note: globe pendants at the graybox pendant spheres (plan, Med); lamp output is a convention
